status: Native development candidate, pending route/circuit/fit acceptance

module.boot_condition: No external pull-up or actuator-domain feedback. Confirm actual module flash-voltage/eFuse/strapping behavior without burning eFuses.

logic_interface.family: JST ZH five positions, keyed, through-hole,3.4mm solder length
logic_interface.driver_input: Dedicated insulated five-wire fanout to original isolated idle XH4 and BOOST-DRAFT1 ZH4; no double-wire crimp assumptions. Both carry only optical-input power/returns/control.
logic_interface.shared_run_load: Includes inherited RUN/Q7 and old idle BJT input plus new boost filtered MOS input. Physical loaded levels and timing remain unqualified.

actuator_interface.candidate: Separate optical THT low-side accessory with hardware RUN, local supervisor, source return star and inductive flyback; UCC PDIP electrical guarantee remains an explicit hold
actuator_interface.firmware_polarity: Increasing energized duty is assumed to increase boost; deenergized plumbing must retain mechanical wastegate spring control

holds: Actual module identity, geometry, eFuse/strapping and reset/download behavior
Schematic, route, ERC/DRC, copper/return review and connector fit
Exact valve, deenergized plumbing, coil R/L, duty/frequency response and independent actuator cutoff
Input buffering, RUN loading, power/return opens, watchdog/interlock and supervisor timing
Flyback energy, thermal and electrical transient measurements
Target scheduler integration, simultaneous idle/boost timing and physical HIL
supersedes: architecture.json remains the original unroutedPH4 candidate

added_parts.note: Permanent GPIO45 carrier pulldown, even with accessory unplugged. Actual memory-voltage strapping/eFuses/boot/reset and leaded part fit unqualified. Compact ordinary leaded body;5mW nominal bias dissipation.

replaced_parts.note: A7 replaces PH4 with distinct ZH5 at the old J21 position. Pins1..4 keep original idle semantics;5adds GPIO45 boost. New insulated Y fanout required: no two wires in a ZH crimp; do not join actuator returns. Original A5/A6 PH4 harness does not mate. Actual crimp/fit/temperature/strain/sealing/clearance unqualified; physical engine writes remain inhibited.

carrier_connector_strategy: Reuse original J21 location with a smaller ZH5 body and equal6mm pin span. Old A6 is unchanged; new A7 uses a separate keyed fanout harness. J24 remains an unused historical proposal, not an A7 PCB connector.
